title: Dumpster
overview: City outskirts, late 90s. In a stifling and toxic slum, where there's no space for naivety nor mistakes, Michele (shortened to Mica) takes refuge in a landfill with his "friend" Luca, who's older than Mica. Their morbid and sick relationship deteriorates further when Mica finds something he shouldn't have come into contact with, but it's something that for him becomes a sudden awakening which will lead Mica to face his greatest fears.
